Garlic Turkey Meatballs
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 22, 2009 - 11:57pm

Ingredients




1 package ground turkey meat
1 egg
1 cup garlic bread crumbs
2 dashes garlic salt or powder

Preparation

1 Defrost turkey meat. Add turkey meat and bread crumbs. Mix well. Add egg to mixture. Mix well until completely blended. Roll meat into any sized meat balls. Spray pan with pam. 2 Place them on a frying pan over a medium flame/heat. Move pan around several times to brown the meat balls all around. After several minutes cooking, cut one open and check for color. If still red, let it cook for longer. If light brown, they are ready. 3 Take them off and place on a plate. Dash garlic salt or powder once. Flip meat balls over then dash again. 4 Enjoy. 5 Serve with pasta. 6 Submitted by: Charlie T-
